name: poki
text: Your AI can now use your iPhone. Poki is a free, open-source tool that taps, swipes and types on your phone for you. Plug it into Claude Code or Codex, then just ask: search esp32 in Chrome and summarize the top result. It remembers past tasks and runs them faster next time. You need a Mac. Comment POKI and I'll send you the link.

name: machine9
text: Type slash x-ray, a hard drive… and you get this. Type slash explain 3D, how a car engine works… and you get this. Type slash explode, a smartwatch… and you get this. Comment MACHINE and I'll send you the prompts.

name: fly9
text: Type slash explain 3D, how a plane flies… and you get this. Type slash cutaway, a rocket… and you get this. Type slash orbit, the space station… and you get this. Comment FLY and I'll send you the prompts.
